criteria_notes.tam: Total addressable market in USD (higher is better)
criteria_notes.fit: Contest fit: is this a story that wins judges? (higher better)
criteria_notes.risk: Competitive risk — inverse scored (lower competition is better)
criteria_notes.demoable: Can Computer + 2 humans ship a visible prototype by June 2?

context.competition_notes: Adjustify (~400 customers, no AI), IAdjust (legacy). No AI-native player.
context.traction_notes: Warm network has 5+ PAs. Discovery calls revealed $5-10k/claim loss from deadline misses.
context.why_it_wins: Clear $/claim pain. 30k fragmented operators. Fast demo: claim-deadline tracker + letter generator.

context.competition_notes: CoreLogic + ATTOM + Black Knight dominate. 3-5yr contract lock-in.
context.traction_notes: SMB title agents pay $300-500/mo for workflow on top of CoreLogic. Can we disrupt?
context.why_it_wins: Massive TAM. But moat is ingest pipelines — hard to ship in 8 weeks.

context.competition_notes: ServiceTitan adding remediation vertical FY26. Encircle exists but weak.
context.traction_notes: Remediators spend 40% of time on insurance paperwork. Photo-to-report would save 4h/job.
context.why_it_wins: Fragmented ~30k operators. Photo intake → S520-compliant report demo is demoable.

context.competition_notes: Billd + Siteline raised Series B. Moat getting hard.
context.traction_notes: Subs wait 60-90 days. Lien-waiver-to-invoice automation is universal pain.
context.why_it_wins: Clear pain. But funded incumbents + banking complexity make demo-by-June hard.

context.competition_notes: iLevel/Dynamo/Addepar own enterprise. Smaller funds DIY in Excel.
context.traction_notes: Mid-market GPs manually reconcile LP capital calls monthly.
context.why_it_wins: High revenue per customer. Long sales cycles kill 8-week traction.

context.traction_notes: Franchise ops juggle Xactimate + DASH + QuickBooks. Overlapping with mold.
context.why_it_wins: Similar dynamics to mold. Wider but more crowded.

context.traction_notes: Probate attorneys do 80% repeatable paperwork. High individual touch.
context.why_it_wins: Clean repeatable workflow. Demo-able. But slow B2B motion — buyer is attorneys.
Plausible but no unique moat thesis. Distractor.

context.competition_notes: FuneralOne, Parting Pro. Sleepy market, old tech.
context.traction_notes: Stable industry, low churn. Good for cash but bad for contest story.
context.why_it_wins: Demo-able but zero judge-excitement factor. Distractor.
No network edge; no clear moat. Distractor.
